bullets.id: Emas memantul sekitar 0,55% ke kisaran $4.132 pada Kamis setelah sempat menyentuh terendah dua bulan di dekat $4.100, dan Jumat pagi stabil di sekitar $4.150. Lelang obligasi 30 tahun senilai $22 miliar diserap baik (5,618%, bid-to-cover 2,54), sehingga yield mundur. Klaim pengangguran AS turun ke 197.000, minggu keempat di bawah 200.000.
bullets.en: Gold bounced about 0.55% to around $4,132 on Thursday after briefly touching a two-month low near $4,100, and steadied near $4,150 on Friday morning. A $22 billion 30-year bond auction was well received (5.618%, bid-to-cover 2.54), pulling yields lower. US jobless claims fell to 197,000, the fourth straight week below 200,000.

bullets.id: Yield 10 tahun sempat ke 5,35%, tertinggi 24 tahun, lalu turun ke sekitar 5,23%. Indeks dolar melemah tipis ke sekitar 102. Brent melonjak 4,1% ke $104,28 pada Kamis karena serangan terhadap tanker di Selat Hormuz, lalu turun ke sekitar $103,5 setelah Trump menyebut ada pembicaraan produktif dengan Iran. Emas masih turun sekitar 3,3% sebulan dan sekitar 26% di bawah rekor Januari $5.608.
bullets.en: The 10-year yield touched 5.35%, a 24-year high, then eased to about 5.23%. The dollar index slipped slightly to around 102. Brent jumped 4.1% to $104.28 on Thursday on attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, then fell to about $103.5 after Trump cited productive talks with Iran. Gold is still down about 3.3% on the month and about 26% below its January record of $5,608.

bullets.id: Gubernur Fed Waller menyebut kenaikan suku bunga tambahan kemungkinan diperlukan, tetapi ada fleksibilitas soal kecepatannya. Pasar melihat peluang Fed menahan suku bunga Oktober sekitar 82% dan kenaikan Desember sekitar 81%. Support di $4.103, $4.067 dan $4.032; resistance di $4.142 dan $4.163. Berikutnya: sentimen konsumen Jumat malam WIB, CPI AS Rabu, PPI Kamis.
bullets.en: Fed Governor Waller said additional rate hikes are likely needed, but there is flexibility on the pace. Markets see about an 82% chance the Fed holds in October and about 81% odds of a December hike. Support sits at $4,103, $4,067 and $4,032; resistance at $4,142 and $4,163. Next up: consumer sentiment Friday evening WIB, US CPI on Wednesday, PPI on Thursday.

bullets.id: Antam naik Rp7.000 ke Rp2.572.000/gram dan buyback naik Rp10.000 ke Rp2.376.000, sehingga spread menyempit ke Rp196.000 (sekitar 7,6%). Brand lain justru turun: Galeri24 Rp2.505.000 (buyback Rp2.358.000), Rp67.000 lebih murah dari Antam, dan UBS Rp2.529.000 (buyback Rp2.333.000).
bullets.en: Antam rose Rp7,000 to Rp2,572,000/gram and buyback rose Rp10,000 to Rp2,376,000, narrowing the spread to Rp196,000 (about 7.6%). Other brands actually fell: Galeri24 is at Rp2,505,000 (buyback Rp2,358,000), Rp67,000 cheaper than Antam, and UBS at Rp2,529,000 (buyback Rp2,333,000).
